description: One-click deployment configuration for lyrics training notebook

blob_storage.description: Azure Blob Storage containing the lyrics text file for training

notebook.name: lyrics_training_notebook.ipynb
notebook.description: Jupyter notebook for training text generation model on lyrics

model.name: lyrics-text-generation-model
model.description: LSTM-based text generation model trained on lyrics

deployment_options.description: Optional deployment to Azure ML endpoint for real-time inference

setup: 1. Update the azure_ml_workspace section with your Azure ML workspace details
2. Update the blob_storage section with your Azure Storage account details
3. Ensure your lyrics.txt file is uploaded to the specified blob container
4. Open the notebook in Azure ML Studio or Jupyter
deployment: 1. Execute all cells in sequence from top to bottom
2. The notebook will automatically connect to your workspace
3. Data will be loaded from blob storage
4. Model will be trained and registered automatically
5. Set DEPLOY_MODEL=True in section 8 to deploy to endpoint (optional)
configuration: Environment variables can be set instead of hardcoding values:

outputs.registered_model: Model will be registered in Azure ML workspace
outputs.deployment_endpoint: Optional: Scoring URI will be provided if deployed
